titleEn: I Must Have Packed the Ball

pages.text: Picnic day. Cicadas sang. Grandpa packed bread and water in a basket.
Nils wanted to play ball at the lake. He laid a ball, a cup, and a towel on the wooden floor.
Nils put only the cup and towel in the basket. Without looking inside, he shut the lid. "I must have packed the ball."
He slung the basket over his back and hopped outside. The ball stayed alone on the floor.
At the lakeshore, Nils opened the lid.
Huh? Cup and towel, but no ball. He searched inside with both hands.
Even tipping and shaking the basket upside down brought no ball. The lake sparkled, but he couldn't play.
Grandpa asked, "Did you see yourself put the ball in?"
Nils went back along the path. The ball was still on the cabin floor. He scooped it up.
Bounce! Bounce! At the lake, Grandpa and Nils passed the ball. The basket lid was firmly shut.
